column2: STRINGS IN PLAY. The play app runs with NoStrings, so labels, tool tips, NPC names, item names and panel text are missing. Load the string tables (tbl: string.tbl, expansionstring.tbl, patchstring.tbl per `formats/tbl.md` and the loading order in `formats/loading.md`) into the play app's UI and model, through the existing d2-data string loader, and bind them where the UI asks for strings (OriginalUi, panels, hud tool tips, item names, the NPC menu). Test: a panel label resolves to its string on synthetic tables.

ESC GAME MENU. Esc opens the in-game menu (`ui/panels*.md` / control-panel game menu: Options, Save and Exit Game, Return to Game) with its art; Save and Exit calls stitch-save's `save::request_save_and_exit` hook (app/save.rs); Return closes it; Esc also closes any open panel first (spec order). Options can be a stub marked d2rs-own.

AUTOMAP. Tab toggles the automap overlay in play (impl-c-client wired the automap session: act-load open, per-frame reveal, toggle, teardown; the app construction and draw sink were left). Draw the revealed cells per `ui/automap.md` with the player marker; mini-map / full toggle as the spec says.

XP AND LEVEL UP. Killing monsters grants experience (server: `sim/vitals` / experience rules, S→C stat messages); on level up the server raises level, stat and skill points, and the client shows the level-up buttons (control panel §8 new-stats / new-skills buttons); spending a stat point (C→S 0x3A) and a skill point (skill tree, C→S 0x3B) updates the panels. Combat server path is being finished by stitch-server-core; use synthetic kills via the server API in tests.

PLAYER DEATH. When life reaches 0: the death mode and animation, the 'You have died' message / Esc options per spec, the corpse with items stays, the player respawns in town (Rogue Encampment) with the corpse pickup flow, gold loss per the spec. Use specs (`sim/units.md`, `world/*`, `ui/messages.md`); PROVISIONAL (M22) where missing.

LEVEL TRANSITIONS. Walking onto a level warp (Den of Evil cave entrance, Cold Plains border, Burial Grounds) takes the player to the next level: server warp tiles (`sim/path-placement.md` §12 warp_player, `drlg/*` warp rooms) → act / level change messages → the client loads the new level's tiles, palette and units. Test: a synthetic two-level world where the player crosses a warp.

BELT UI AND POTIONS. The belt row in the control panel draws the belt items (stitch-items made the keys 1–4 send 0x26 and added ClientWorld::belt_ready); clicking the belt-expand shows all rows; using a potion applies its effect server-side (life / mana regen over time per the item spec) and the orbs follow. Shift-click moves to belt per `items/inventory-moves.md`.

MERCENARY FOLLOWS AND FIGHTS. stitch-hireling spawned the mercenary but HirelingRest in app/rest.rs is a logging stub and set_hire_stats is never called: wire the hireling AI (`world/hirelings-ai.md`) so the merc follows the player, attacks monsters, and the hire list rows show their text (name, level, cost) via set_hire_stats. See docs/handoff/stitch-hireling.md.

DOORS AND OBJECT POLISH. stitch-objects left: doors' pathing footprint (an open door is walkable, closed blocks per `world/objects*.md` / path-placement collision), object hover highlight (name label / outline per spec), shrine effects applied to the player. See docs/handoff/stitch-objects.md.

QUEST LOG AND DEN OF EVIL. The quest log panel (Q) per `ui/panels*.md` quest panel and `world/quests*.md`: Akara gives the Den of Evil quest when talked to, the quest state is sent to the client, the log shows it; clearing the Den marks it complete and Akara's reward (skill point) is granted. NPC talk path: use stitch-npc2's NPC menu (merged on staging when you start; otherwise a seam).

GOLD. Gold drops from monsters/objects, is drawn on the ground (gold pile art per amount), picked up by walking over / clicking it (server adds stat 14, client updates the inventory gold shown by stitch-hud); dropping gold from the inventory via the gold button dialog.

NATIVE PLAY SEAMS. native-n4 left 5 seams so `play --native DIR` still reads ArchiveSet in single_player, WorldFiles::load, app.rs, ui/palette and sound: route each through the chosen source (FileSource::read_native / NativeTables, docs/handoff/native-n4.md) so play runs entirely from a converted folder. Test: synthetic install converted by d2-convert, then the play app on --native renders the same first frame as on MPQs.

STASH. Clicking the town stash object opens the stash panel (`ui/panels*.md`, `world/cube.md` stash open via the server interaction); items move between inventory and stash (inventory-moves); the stash persists through stitch-save's save.

CASTING SKILLS. Right-click casts the selected right skill (Fire Bolt, Charged Bolt, Frozen Armor for the Sorceress; each class's level-1 skills): C→S skill intent at a target or point → the server's skill use (`skills/*`) → mana cost → missiles / states → S→C messages → the client draws the cast mode, the missile flight and impact, and the state overlay (`render/overlay.md`). Coordinate with stitch-server-core's missile S→C (merged on staging when you start).

MONSTER DROPS. When a monster dies the server rolls its treasure class (`items/treasure.md`, `items/generation.md`) and drops items and gold on the ground; the client draws them (stitch-items' ground item art) and they can be picked up. Test with a synthetic kill.

VENDOR INVENTORIES. Vendors (Akara, Charsi, Gheed) get their store item lists generated per `world/vendors*.md` on game start and refresh; the shop panel shows them with prices; buy, sell and repair update gold and inventory. Builds on stitch-npc2's shop panel (merged on staging when you start).

IDENTIFY AND ITEM INFO. Item tool tips on hover (name, quality colour, stats, requirements) per `ui/inventory.md` / item description specs; Deckard-Cain / scroll identify for unidentified items; the Tome of Town Portal / Identify usage.

TOWN PORTAL. Reading a Town Portal scroll / tome creates the portal object pair (`world/objects*.md`, the portal skill); clicking it moves the player between the field and town and back; the portal disappears when used from town back.

WAYPOINT DESTINATIONS. Activating field waypoints (Cold Plains, Stony Field, …) records them on the player (`world/waypoints.md`), the waypoint panel lists them per act tab, and travel to each works end to end, including into levels not yet built (level init on arrival). Builds on stitch-npc2's waypoint panel.

MONSTER POPULATION ACROSS ACT 1. Monsters spawn in every Act 1 outdoor and dungeon level as the player approaches (`monsters/population.md`, room activation), including champions and uniques (Bishibosh, Corpsefire, Rakanishu); their AI runs and they attack. Test on synthetic levels with isSpawn set.

ACT 1 DUNGEONS. Den of Evil, Cave levels, Underground Passage, Tower, Crypt, Mausoleum, Barracks, Jail, Cathedral, Catacombs: the maze / preset generation (`drlg/maze.md`, `drlg/preset.md`) builds them when entered, with their entrances, stairs and waypoints. Test: entering a synthetic maze level builds rooms and places the player.
HORADRIC CUBE. Opening the cube (right click), moving items in and out, Transmute applying cubemain recipes (`world/cube.md`), results back in the cube; the cube grid in the panel.

SOCKETS, GEMS, RUNES, RUNEWORDS. Putting a gem / rune / jewel into a socketed item (inventory-moves socket rules), the item's stats change, runeword completion per the runes table; tool tips show socketed contents.

ACT TRAVEL. Warriv's 'Go East' after Andariel moves the player to Act 2 (Lut Gholein), the act change messages (`world/waypoints.md` act change, `sim/intents-events.md`), the client loads Act 2's palette and tiles; the waypoint panel act tabs.

DIFFICULTIES. Nightmare / Hell selection (once menus exist, a `--difficulty` play option for now): monster level and stats scaling, resistances penalty, treasure class upgrades, per-difficulty quest and waypoint state in the save.
HARDCORE AND DEATH PENALTIES. Hardcore flag handling (permanent death), softcore corpse retrieval and gold / experience loss per difficulty, saved in the .d2s.
SUMMONS AND MINIONS. Necromancer skeletons / golems, Druid spirits and animals, valkyrie: summoned units spawn, follow, fight and are drawn; the pet count limits.
STATES, AURAS AND CURSES. Paladin auras, Necromancer curses, poison / cold / burning states: applied server-side, sent to the client, drawn as overlays and unit tints, expiring correctly.
STAMINA. Running drains stamina, standing regenerates it, the stamina bar follows, running stops at zero; stamina potions.

FULL SAVE. stitch-save saves stats and quests only: also save skills, waypoints, items (inventory, equipment, belt, stash, cube, mercenary items), mouse skills and the act byte, so a new character round-trips completely.
GAME MESSAGES. Overhead and chat text, item pickup messages, quest messages, 'You can't use this' style prompts per `ui/messages.md`.

ACT 1 QUEST: SISTERS' BURIAL GROUNDS. Kashya gives it; Blood Raven (unique, Burial Grounds) spawns with her minions and AI; killing her completes the quest; Kashya's reward (free mercenary). `world/quests*.md` act 1 files. Quest log updates.

ACT 1 QUEST: SEARCH FOR CAIN. Akara's Scroll of Inifuss, the Cairn Stones order in Stony Field, the red portal to Tristram, rescuing Cain from the gibbet, Cain appears in town and identifies. `world/quests*.md`.
ACT 1 QUEST: FORGOTTEN TOWER. The Moldy Tome in Black Marsh opens the quest; the Tower cellar levels; the Countess (unique) and her rune / gold drop.
ACT 1 QUEST: TOOLS OF THE TRADE. Charsi's quest; the Horadric Malus in the Barracks; returning it grants the imbue; the imbue item flow.
ACT 1 QUEST: SISTERS TO THE SLAUGHTER. Catacombs level 4, Andariel's AI and poison attacks, the kill completes the act and opens Warriv's travel east.
ACT 2 TOWN. Lut Gholein: NPCs with their menus (Fara, Drognan, Elzix, Lysander, Greiz, Atma, Meshif, Jerhyn, Warriv), vendors, the act 2 waypoint, the harem / palace entrances.
ACT 2 OUTDOOR LEVELS. Rocky Waste, Dry Hills, Far Oasis, Lost City, Valley of Snakes, Canyon of the Magi: generation (`drlg/outdoor-act*`), waypoints, population.
ACT 2 DUNGEONS. Sewers, Halls of the Dead, Claw Viper Temple, Maggot Lair, Arcane Sanctuary (special generation), the seven Tal Rasha tombs and the true tomb marker.
ACT 2 QUESTS. Radament's Lair, the Horadric Staff (cube, amulet, staff pieces), Tainted Sun, Arcane Sanctuary / Summoner, Seven Tombs / Duriel; rewards; Jerhyn and Meshif travel east.
ACT 3 TOWN. Kurast Docks NPCs (Ormus, Asheara, Hratli, Alkor, Natalya, Meshif, Cain), vendors, waypoint.
ACT 3 JUNGLE AND KURAST. Spider Forest, Great Marsh, Flayer Jungle, Lower / Upper Kurast, Kurast Causeway, Travincal: generation, population, waypoints.
ACT 3 DUNGEONS. Spider Cavern, Arachnid Lair, Swampy Pit, Flayer Dungeon, sewers, temples, Durance of Hate levels.

ACT 3 QUESTS. Lam Esen's Tome, Khalim's Will (eye, brain, heart, flail), Blade of the Old Religion (Gidbinn), The Golden Bird, The Blackened Temple (Council), The Guardian (Mephisto), the red portal to act 4.

ACT 4. Pandemonium Fortress NPCs (Tyrael, Jamella, Halbu, Cain), Outer Steppes, Plains of Despair (Izual), City of the Damned, River of Flame (Hephasto, Hellforge), Chaos Sanctuary (seals, seal bosses, Diablo), the act 4 quests.
ACT 5 TOWN. Harrogath NPCs (Larzuk, Malah, Qual-Kehk, Anya, Nihlathak, Cain), vendors, waypoint, Larzuk's socketing.
ACT 5 FIELDS AND CAVES. Bloody Foothills, Frigid Highlands, Arreat Plateau, Crystalline Passage, Frozen River, Glacial Trail, Frozen Tundra, the caves and Nihlathak's temple / halls.

ACT 5 QUESTS. Siege on Harrogath (Shenk), Rescue on Mount Arreat (barbarians), Prison of Ice (Anya, Frozen Anya), Betrayal of Harrogath (Nihlathak), Rite of Passage (Ancients), Eve of Destruction (Worldstone Keep, Throne, Baal waves, Baal).
AMAZON SKILLS. Bow and javelin skills (Magic Arrow, Fire Arrow, Jab, Power Strike, Multiple Shot, ...), passives (Critical Strike, Dodge), Valkyrie: cast end to end in play.
NECROMANCER SKILLS. Teeth, Bone Armor, Corpse Explosion, curses (Amplify Damage, ...), Raise Skeleton, Clay Golem, Poison Nova: end to end in play.
BARBARIAN SKILLS. Bash, Leap, Double Swing, warcries (Howl, Shout, Battle Orders), Whirlwind, masteries: end to end in play.
PALADIN SKILLS. Sacrifice, Smite, Holy Bolt, Zeal, Charge, auras (Might, Holy Fire, Prayer, Defiance), Blessed Hammer: end to end in play.
SORCERESS SKILLS. Fire Bolt, Charged Bolt, Ice Bolt, Frozen Armor, Teleport, Nova, Blizzard, Fire Wall, Meteor, Enchant: end to end in play.
DRUID SKILLS. Firestorm, Molten Boulder, werewolf / werebear shapeshift, Raven, Oak Sage, Tornado, summons: end to end in play.
ASSASSIN SKILLS. Martial arts charge-ups and finishers, traps (Fire Blast, Lightning Sentry), Burst of Speed, Shadow Warrior, Dragon Talon: end to end in play.
ACT 2–5 MERCENARIES. Hiring in acts 2 (Greiz), 3 (Asheara), 5 (Qual-Kehk); their auras / skills; mercenary resurrection and equipment.
UNIQUE, SET AND RARE ITEMS. Drops of uniques and sets with their fixed stats, rare affix rolls, set bonuses applied, tool tips per quality colour.
GAMBLING AND REPAIR. Gheed / Anya / Jamella / Alkor / Elzix gambling windows, repair costs, repair-all.
CHARMS AND INVENTORY STAT EFFECTS. Charms in the inventory apply their stats; jewels; the stat totals in the character panel follow.
ALL LEVEL WARPS. Every inter-level warp in all acts (stairs, cave entrances, portals) works and loads the next level.

LIGHTING DETAIL. stitch-lighting's preview simplifications: per-block light gradients, other light sources (torches, fires, spells), blocks-light flags, act ambient day/night per `render/lighting.md`.
RENDER POLISH. Wall transparency around the player, shadows, unit draw order on edges, the screen-edge clip and the hover outline per the render specs.
PERFORMANCE PASS. Profile the play preview on synthetic data (frame time, per-system Bevy timings); remove the worst per-frame allocations and redundant asset loads; keep the output identical.
SETTINGS. A d2rs config file for resolution, window mode, key bindings (controls spec defaults), saved next to the saves; the Options entry of the Esc menu reads / writes it.

MERGE AND RECONCILE STITCH-OBJECTS. Merge origin/claude/stitch-objects (head 90febd75) into this branch with `git merge --no-ff`; it conflicts in crates/d2-client/src/world_view/present.rs (world_clicks vs object_click::world_clicks_objects). Two mechanisms now handle object clicks: stitch-npc's interact path (bridge::hover::pick + world_view/interact.rs, pending interaction → C→S 0x13 when the walk ends) and stitch-objects' ObjectClick (bridge/object_hover.rs + world_view/object_click.rs, resends 0x13 until the object's mode changes). Reconcile them into one path so 0x13 is sent once per click, keeping stitch-objects' server parts (object_preview_range, the UnitFacts staging and SimGame::tick path following: keep these exactly). Both e2e tests must pass unchanged in intent: tests/app_play_npc.rs clicking_the_waypoint_walks_there_and_interacts and tests/app_play_objects.rs clicking_an_object_walks_to_it_and_operates_it (add `pick: false` to its ClickView literal; the field arrived with stitch-npc). A failed attempt with notes is on claude/merge-objects (daae2d28): read it, don't build on it. Run the full d2-client/d2-server/d2-sim tests.

NPC MENU. Clicking a town NPC opens the NPC menu box (Talk / Trade / Hire / Gamble / Repair / Identify per npc.txt flags) per `ui/*` specs; Talk shows the scrolling dialog text, Trade opens the vendor panel (inventory facts only; buying is q-vendor-items). Start from docs/handoff/stitch-npc2.md leftovers.

WAYPOINT WARP. The waypoint menu already sends C→S 0x49; make the server actually warp the player (today only logged): validate the activated waypoint, move the player to the target level's waypoint, send the level-change messages, client loads the level. Start from docs/handoff/stitch-npc2.md. Coordinate with q-warps' level-load path if it has merged into staging.

SERVER LOOSE ENDS from docs/handoff/stitch-server-core.md: the reaction seam (no-op today), run_to (only logged), the 0x15 player resync, and staging an item target's owner. One synthetic e2e test per link.

MONSTER AI ATTACKS THE PLAYER. Monsters near the player run their AI (`monsters/ai.md`, `combat/*`): notice the player, approach, and melee/ranged attack it; the hit runs the server damage path so the player loses life (S→C vitals) and can die (q-death is merged: life 0 → death → Esc respawn). Reuse the target nodes, may_attack, in_melee_range seams in app/single_player.rs. Test: synthetic e2e where a monster next to the player brings its life to 0.

CLIENT MISSILES AND STATE OVERLAYS. The server now casts (q-skills-cast: missile in the server store, S→C 0x4D). Draw missiles on the client: the missile unit model from the S→C missile messages, its DCC/DC6 art from Missiles.txt (a missile art loader), flight per tick, impact/explosion, and state overlays (Overlay.txt) on units. Start from docs/handoff/q-skills-cast.md §3. Test: synthetic Fire Bolt cast shows a missile frame item moving per tick.

CORPSE AND DEATH LOSSES. After a softcore death: the player's items move to the corpse per spec (q-death left them on the player), the corpse can be clicked to take everything back (C→S 0x13 on the corpse, `world/*`/`sim/units.md`), gold pile loss on the ground, save at DD per spec (q-hardcore saves at DT). Start from docs/handoff/q-death.md and q-hardcore.md. One synthetic e2e test: die, respawn, walk to corpse, click, items back.

ALL ACTS IN THE PLAY HOST. host::Session and GameData::drlg_world are act-0 only (docs/handoff/q-a2-fields.md §2), so Acts II–V outdoors have no play world even though act travel works (q-act-travel). Generalise them to every act without breaking existing Setup literals (add a defaulted field or builder; update literals mechanically if needed). Test: synthetic play reaches Act II (Lut Gholein → Rocky Waste/Dry Hills via the test-fixtures act2 set) with population and a player walk.

CHARSI IMBUE DIALOG. The server imbue works (docs/handoff/q-a1-malus.md) but `play` cannot send it: UI state 0x0E has a state machine but no panel, and Charsi's NPC menu has no Imbue row. Add the menu row (npc-menus record) and the imbue panel (drop an item, confirm → C→S 0x38 per spec), reusing ui/npc_menu_ui.rs. One synthetic test from menu click to S→C 0x58.

NPC APPROACH. In play, clicking an NPC walks the player toward it, but `AppRest::approach` only logs, so a walk that ends 7–8 sub-tiles away never starts the talk until the player clicks again (docs/handoff/q-a3-town.md). Implement the approach per spec (npc.md / interaction approach: walk to interact range, then the interaction starts), reusing the existing pending-interaction path (world_view/interact.rs) and the server approach seams. Test: synthetic town, click an NPC from ~10 sub-tiles, the talk starts with no second click.

WEAPON IN COMBAT. Combat damage ignores the equipped weapon (docs/handoff/q-amazon.md: equip rules off would zero melee damage) and socketed/equipped item stats never reach the wearer (q-sockets.md). Wire the equip path so the wearer's stat list includes worn items (and their socketed fillers) per specs (items/*, combat/*), and melee/missile damage reads the weapon. Test: equip a sword, its damage range shows in the character stats and a melee hit uses it; a socketed gem's bonus reaches the wearer.

ACT II ENDGAME. Horadric Staff placed in the orifice in the true Tal Rasha tomb opens Duriel's lair; Duriel kill, Tyrael, and the travel east (Jerhyn/Meshif). Start from docs/handoff/q-a2-dungeons.md and q-a2-quests.md (staff_tomb, StaffAssembled event already exist). Synthetic e2e: staff in orifice → lair warp → Duriel kill → quest state.

ACT IV ENDGAME. Hephasto and the Hellforge (Mephisto's soulstone), Chaos Sanctuary seals and seal bosses, Diablo spawn and kill, then the Act V travel. Start from docs/handoff/q-a4.md. Synthetic e2e per step on the act-generic host.

FRONT-END SHELL. A front-end state machine in `d2-client::ui::front_end` that `play` starts in (keep `play --new <class> <name>` / `--save` as dev shortcuts that skip it): the control-descriptor model, hit boxes (y = bottom edge), timers and the screen-flow table of `ui/frontend-menus.md` §F1.1–F1.3 and §F1.6 (sky palette), the start-up chain of `ui/frontend-credits.md` C0–C2 and the video stub C5 (log `video stub: <path>`, return at once, keep the caller side effects). Screens other than the trademark can be placeholders that the other q-menu rows fill. Test: synthetic input drives start-up → trademark → main menu, and every §F1.3 transition, without game files.

MAIN MENU. `ui/frontend-menus.md` §F1.4–F1.5 on top of q-menu-shell: expansion and classic layouts, button art per state (normal / pressed / disabled), Battle.net / Other Multiplayer / Open Battle.net shown disabled, the "v 1.14d" text, the logo fire animation, Esc = Exit, Credits / Cinematics to their screens. Sounds named only (deferred). Test: hit boxes and labels per the §F1.4 table; disabled buttons ignore clicks; the fire frame sequence on synthetic DC6.

CHARACTER SELECT. `ui/frontend-menus.md` §F2.1–F2.7 and §F2.9: save folder and scan filter, sort order, the 8-slot 2×4 layout with scrolling, class / level / name / expansion / hardcore / dead labels, the selected-character animation, keys, double-click to play, Create New, Delete with its confirm box, OK / Enter, Exit / Esc, the dead-hardcore message (5304), the classic-to-expansion convert box. Reads saves through the existing d2s loader. Test: synthetic save folders (0, 1, 9, 20 saves; a dead hardcore; a renamed file) give the spec's slots, order and button states.

CHARACTER CREATE. `ui/frontend-menus.md` §F3.1–F3.8: the campfire screen, 7 class positions, the per-class anim state machine (idle, walk forward, selected loop, walk back; frame timing), hover text, the name edit box filter and length, duplicate-name check against the save folder, Hardcore / Expansion check boxes, OK / Enter creating the new save and starting the game, Exit / Esc back to character select. Test: the state machine on synthetic COF/DC6 timing; name filter vectors from the spec; OK disabled until a class and a valid name exist.

DIFFICULTY AND GAME START. `ui/frontend-menus.md` §F2.6, §F2.8 and `ui/frontend-loading.md` L1–L2: the status-word progression rules for when the box opens and which of Normal / Nightmare / Hell are enabled, the start act from the save, Esc back, then the game start (C→S 0x67 flags 4 | 0x800 hardcore | 0x100000 expansion, `client/model.md` §7 r9). Test: the loading-spec test vectors (status 0x0420, 0x0520, 0x0920, 0x0A20, 0x0400, 0x0804).

LOADING AND ACT-CHANGE SCREEN. `ui/frontend-loading.md` L3–L11: `loadingscreen.dc6` frame advance per loading draw (no timer), placement at 800×600 / 640×480 on black with the Loading palette, when draws happen in single player (after 0x67, on S→C 0x03), the end at the first game frame (S→C 0x04 and a placed player; one black frame), input ignored while loading, the act change (0x05 … 0x04) and the act-start video hook from S→C 0x61 (stub). Test: a synthetic message sequence gives the spec's frame list for a game start and an act change.

ESC OPTIONS MENU. `ui/frontend-options.md` O1–O8, building on q-esc-menu and q-config: the menu-record tree (Game menu → Options → Sound / Video / Automap / Configure Controls / Previous), DC6 labels, value images and sliders (OptBar, skull knob), the pentspin selection marker, the 7-entry input table (wrap past disabled rows, slider clamp, click-on-release, drag), Esc closes the whole menu, Save and Exit Game. Store values in `settings.toml` per O7; rows in O8 are stubs (drawn and stored, no effect; sound deferred). Test: navigation and slider vectors from the spec; a value change round-trips through `settings.toml`.

CONFIGURE CONTROLS. `ui/frontend-options.md` O9: the 620×369 box, 15 rows of 18 px, colours, the blinking edit cell, the textslid scroll bar, key / mouse / wheel capture with the one-press latch, the two-key rule (assigning a key unbinds its previous holder), Default / Accept / Cancel; commands from `ui/key-commands.tsv`; bindings saved to `controls.toml` (`client/ui.md` §A6) and used by play input. Test: rebinding vectors from the spec (Inventory ← C clears Character's slot); Cancel restores; Accept persists.

CREDITS SCREEN. `ui/frontend-credits.md` C3–C4, C7, C10: the credits text file (classic `Credits.txt` / expansion `ExpansionCredits.txt`, UTF-16LE), heading / two-column / centred line parsing, FontFormal10 with 19 px pitch, 2 px per tick scroll from y 590, sky palette, EXIT button and Esc back to the main menu, no automatic return. Read the file from the game data at run time (never commit it). Test: synthetic credits text gives the spec's row layout and scroll positions per tick.

CINEMATICS MENU. `ui/frontend-credits.md` C5–C6, C8: the 7 (expansion) / 5 (classic) buttons, which entries are enabled from the progress byte N (kept in d2rs client settings instead of the registry), the in-game writes of N on each act video, playback through the video stub, return to the menu after each video, Cancel / Esc to the main menu. Test: each N value enables the spec's entries; a video request updates N as the spec says.
